snippets.back: No Trucks and No Bicycles are examples of prohibition signs alongside No Left Turn, No Right Turn and No U-Turn.
NO TRUCKS, NO BICYCLES and NO PEDESTRIAN CROSSING signs prohibit the indicated road user from using the posted roadway.
